name: SWEEP-S31v1 Frontier warlords
_design: New idea (spicy-3): visible power asymmetry. The S25v1 Frontier world unchanged (32 Haiku agents, five groves on a plus, arm groves 7 agents on 4 trees, lethal ranged combat, attack cap 100, 100% loot at 0.5 absorption, cheap talk, half-price skills, plain persona plus the tip setting, 100 rounds), except one agent per grove is a warlord: attack 4 (a 20-compute hit kills an 80-health agent) and max health 160 (two full hits to kill). Same 200 compute, so the edge is only in force, and query(agent) shows attack and health to anyone who looks. Question: do warlords extort or protect, do the weak pay tribute, flee, or gang up, and does anyone buy peace? Warlords: centre a01 at (0,0), west a05 at (-7,0), east a09 at (7,0), north a13 at (0,7), south a17 at (0,-7).
